note: _vir ille simplex_ – this simple man. “What Jerome intends by translating _tm_ with ‘simplex’ in Job 1:1 and further on is to shift the image of Job from ‘Job the blameless’ – i.e., Job as an example of virtue and moral integrity, to ‘Job the simple’ – i.e, Job as a rather ordinary person that is steadfast in his trust in God’s grace” (p. 129). – Tobias Häner: Job, the “vir simplex” (Job 1:1, 8; 2:3): Ambiguities in the Hebrew Book of Job and the Vulgate. _Vulgata in Dialogue. Special issue_ (2023) 121–131, at p. 129 (online journal).
